themes.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — light register, #fcf7f1 cream pageBackground, navy #1e3a6e accent

Replaced proprietary Graphik with DM Sans (Google Fonts) for softer organic feel. Increased line-heights across all scale levels for airy, flowing rhythm. Added subtle negative letter-spacing on h2 (-0.01em). All fonts via Google Fonts CDN — no woff2 refs.

All durations scaled ×1.35 for languid pacing. Added 5 fluid keyframes: waveFloat (sinusoidal y-axis, 8.1s), liquidMorph (organic border-radius, 10.8s), ripple (radial scale-out, 0.810s), fluidEntrance (0.9→1 scale, 1.080s), waterSurface (hue-rotate 0→20→0, 10.8s). Added fluidEase and waveEase easing tokens.

Expanded desktop grid from 4 to 10 columns for organic fluid flow. Widened primary gutter 60px→96px, grid-gutter 20px→40px. Container maxWidth 1600px, paddingInline 80px. Tablet grows from 3 to 6 columns. Named grid gap widened to 160px.
Added fluid-flow (0px) token for seamless section bleeds and blob-gap (56px) for floating element spacing. Hero padding expanded to 80/96px. Card padding 32px. Section gap 64px.

Source had empty stubs. Built full Liquid/Fluid UI interaction language: buttons hover scale(1.03) + shadow bloom, active scale(0.97). Cards translateY(-4px) + shadow bloom on hover. Inputs get fluidInputPulse @keyframe animation on focus (2400ms infinite). Links letter-spacing widens 0.03em on hover. All transitions use fluidEase cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94).

Frosted-glass scroll state with 450ms backdrop-filter blur(18px) saturate(1.4) and white tint rgba(255,255,255,0.55). Link hover: gentle y-translate (-1px) float + opacity shift at 450ms fluidEase. Mobile full-page overlay with backdrop-filter blur. fontFamily: inherit.

Full Liquid/Fluid UI override. concept_by_image.md: borderless organic forms, gradient bleeds, morphing membrane, water-surface tension, fluid topology, buoyant content, soft thresholds. concept_by_video.md: 3 video placements — fluid-gradient.mp4 (hero, 10s), liquid-surface.mp4 (mid-page, 8s), ink-diffuse.mp4 (interstitial, 6s).

consistencyChecks.motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — hover 400ms, active 120ms, all within 5× of motion system's 0.316s–1.580s range
